WITH channel_match AS (
  SELECT c.*
  FROM social_media.channel_identities ci
  JOIN social_media.clients c ON c.client_id = ci.client_id
  WHERE ci.channel = $1 AND ci.external_sender_id = $2 AND ci.active = true
  LIMIT 1
), resolved AS (
  SELECT * FROM channel_match
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.* FROM social_media.clients c
  WHERE c.client_id = $3 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_match)
  LIMIT 1
), updated_message AS (
  UPDATE social_media.messages m
  SET client_id = r.client_id
  FROM resolved r
  WHERE m.message_id = $4::uuid
  RETURNING m.*
), inserted_event AS (
  INSERT INTO social_media.events (
    correlation_id, client_id, event_type, workflow_name, details
  )
  SELECT $5::uuid, r.client_id, 'CLIENT_IDENTIFIED',
         '02 - Identificacao do Cliente e Marca',
         jsonb_build_object('message_id', m.message_id, 'brand_name', r.brand_name, 'channel', m.channel)
  FROM updated_message m CROSS JOIN resolved r
  RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT
  m.message_id, m.correlation_id, m.channel, m.external_message_id,
  m.sender_id, m.body AS message, r.client_id, r.brand_name,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'client_id', r.client_id, 'brand_name', r.brand_name,
    'business_type', r.business_type, 'logo_path', r.logo_path,
    'primary_colors', r.primary_colors, 'secondary_colors', r.secondary_colors,
    'fonts', r.fonts, 'tone', r.tone, 'address', r.address,
    'phone', r.phone, 'instagram', r.instagram, 'website', r.website,
    'rules', r.brand_rules, 'products', r.products, 'services', r.services,
    'reference_images', r.reference_images, 'templates', r.templates,
    'restrictions', r.restrictions, 'preferences', r.preferences
  ) AS brand_profile,
  COALESCE((SELECT config_value FROM social_media.runtime_config WHERE config_key = 'ai_provider'), 'mock') AS ai_provider,
  COALESCE((SELECT config_value FROM social_media.runtime_config WHERE config_key = 'ai_model'), 'mock-v1') AS ai_model,
  true AS client_identified
FROM updated_message m CROSS JOIN resolved r;
